run_jobs_status: run the jobs_status CLI to fetch all running or complete DataTrove jobs from a logging folder
run_jobs_status_with_prefix: run the jobs_status CLI with a log_prefix to scan only specific job logging directories
run_jobs_status_hide_complete: run the jobs_status CLI with --hide_complete to display only incomplete jobs
run_jobs_status_custom_path: run the jobs_status CLI with a custom path argument pointing to a DataTrove logging directory
summarize_jobs_status: summarize the jobs_status CLI tool that checks DataTrove job completion by scanning executor.json and completions directories
